title: CmdPal: Bookmark {placeholder} field retains last-entered value on every subsequent open
author: tbertran
summary: Command Palette bookmark placeholder controls are cached with the bookmark command and retain StringParameterRun values after a successful launch.

status.label: Focused design ready
status.detail: The deterministic reproduction and source analysis match current main.

next_action.label: Design placeholder reset lifecycle
next_action.reason: Choose and test the lifecycle boundary that clears values without breaking failed launches or repeated placeholders.

judgment.rationale: The current object lifetime and missing reset are directly visible in source.
evidence: The form starts empty only on first open, then reuses the last value.
The issue identifies the involved classes.
Current main stores StringParameterRun instances on a long-lived page.
LaunchWithCurrentValues dismisses after success without clearing runs.
judgment.recommended_action: Design and test reset on successful launch or page activation; do not approve until lifecycle and failure semantics are finalized.

issue_context.summary: Dynamic bookmark fields persist for the session although users expect a fresh parameter form for each invocation.
known_information: A `{placeholder}` bookmark starts empty on first open.
Later opens are prefilled with the last submitted value.
No comments, assignee, duplicate, or linked fix exists.
inferences: Clearing only after successful launch likely preserves failed input for correction.
Rebuilding the command on every activation may be broader than necessary.
issue_context.analysis: The source trace matches current main, so more diagnostics would not change triage; reset timing and tests are the remaining work.
initial_investigation: BookmarkListItem.cs creates and retains one BookmarkPlaceholderPage as the command.
BuildParameterRuns creates StringParameterRun objects once in the constructor.
LaunchWithCurrentValues reads Text and dismisses without reset.
The parameter-page implementation landed in #47886; no later reset fix appears.
